title: The Gospel
message: The gospel starts with bad news before it gets good: all of us have fallen short of God's glory. But that's not where it ends. "God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us." Not after we cleaned up. Not once we earned it. While we were still far off. Grace means the gift is already paid for — your part is to receive it, not to earn it.
explore: God, humanity, brokenness/sin, Christ, cross, resurrection, grace and new life.
reflect: Where have you been trying to earn what God offers as a gift?
pray: God, thank You for Your grace. Help me understand the depth of what You have done through Christ.
